title: 56% Of The Ocean Changed Color
hook: Satellites detected a global color shift across more ocean than land.
closing: Ocean color tracks microscopic life, so a global shift can signal ecosystem change.
question: What is changing beneath the surface?

segments.say: 56 percent of the ocean surface changed color. More than half the sea now reflects light differently.
A climate model predicted 50 percent of the ocean would shift. Later satellite observations matched the warning.
Changed ocean area reached 203 million square kilometers. The shift covers more space than all Earth's land.
